title: Why A4 Keeps Its Shape When You Fold It
parts: Fold an A4 sheet in half, and the halves keep the shape of the whole.
Wikipedia says ISO paper sizes share one ratio: the square root of two.
Where did the shape come from? Wikipedia says it was first mentioned in a letter written on October twenty-fifth, seventeen eighty-six.
The writer was a German physics professor, Lichtenberg.
A Cambridge translation says he planned to cut ordinary writing paper to the shape he wanted.
Then he found, with pleasure, that the paper already had that shape.
He wrote that the shape appeared not to have emerged by accident.
